label: Enhanced prompts keep their highlights, and stuck tools come back

sections.title: Small fixes you'll feel every day
items: Tweak a prompt after `Enhance?` without losing its help. The terms it corrected stay highlighted while you edit the rest of your message, and hovering one still shows what you originally typed. Only a term you change yourself drops its highlight, since the explanation no longer fits. The highlights carry over into your sent message too.

A tool server that failed to start gets another try every time you start fresh with `New`. If it connects this time, its tools are ready in your new chat without restarting the app. Servers waiting for you to sign in are left alone until you do.
